scope: Dated public Cloud Storage contract baseline and emulator project requirements.
counting_rules: Rows are implementation tracking units, not independent product capabilities or estimated effort.
Keep api_operation, behavior and project_requirement denominators separate.
REST, XML, native RPC, shared interfaces and MCP are deliberately separate transport surfaces.
Schema fields and query parameters are tracked in separate inventories, not added to feature totals.
A phase identifies the first recommended implementation focus, not permission to mark the entire row complete.
Decompose selected rows into acceptance cases; record only executed tests and existing evidence.

features.title: Bucket and object name validation
features.notes: Validate UTF-8 byte lengths, reserved names, and flat/HNS differences.

features.title: Literal object names and URI encoding
features.notes: Preserve slashes, percent signs, plus signs, Unicode, and repeated/trailing separators without filesystem path semantics.

features.title: JSON integer representation
features.notes: Encode documented int64/uint64 values as strings without precision loss.

features.title: Partial response fields selectors
features.notes: Implement nested selectors, arrays, wildcards, invalid selector errors.

features.title: Projection full/noAcl
features.notes: Return or omit ACL and owner fields according to the API and permission.

features.title: PUT replacement versus PATCH merge
features.notes: Distinguish absent, null, empty collections and replacement of mutable configuration.

features.title: HTTP and JSON error envelopes
features.notes: Track status, reason, domain, message, and header shape for negative cases.

features.title: HTTP batch request format
features.notes: Multipart request/response boundaries, content IDs, per-part failures, ordering limits; separate from Storage batch operations.

features.title: Strong data and listing consistency
features.notes: A completed mutation is visible to immediate reads and listings.

features.title: Authorization propagation model
features.notes: Optional simulated delay; do not weaken data consistency to imitate IAM propagation.

features.title: Generation/metageneration preconditions
features.notes: Atomic check and mutate; cover match/not-match, zero sentinel, source/destination, incompatible pairs.

features.title: HTTP conditional requests
features.notes: ETag and date conditions where supported; distinguish 304 and 412.

features.title: Pagination and token validation
features.notes: Correct continuation, lexicographic order, empty pages, malformed tokens and concurrent changes.

features.title: Project and billing context
features.notes: Project ownership, userProject, Requester Pays validation; no real billing.

features.title: Bucket identity and timestamps
features.notes: id, name, projectNumber, etag, generation, metageneration, timeCreated, updated, selfLink.

features.title: Labels
features.notes: Validate and round-trip labels with PATCH deletion semantics.

features.title: Location and placement configuration
features.notes: location, locationType, customPlacementConfig.dataLocations and allowed combinations; local metadata only.

features.title: Storage classes
features.notes: STANDARD, NEARLINE, COLDLINE, ARCHIVE, RAPID plus accepted legacy aliases; enforce restrictions without claiming cloud-tier hardware.

features.title: RPO and replication properties
features.notes: rpo, satisfiesPZI/PZS; only local configuration/status simulation.

features.title: Bucket default encryption key
features.notes: encryption.defaultKmsKeyName metadata and inheritance; fake KMS identity must be documented.

features.title: Encryption enforcement configuration
features.notes: Google-managed, customer-managed, customer-supplied restrictionMode/effectiveTime; validate combinations.

features.title: IP filter configuration
features.notes: Public CIDRs, VPC sources, mode, service-agent/cross-org exceptions; local source identity simulation.

features.title: CORS configuration round-trip
features.notes: Origin/method/header/maxAge validation and independent endpoint behavior tests.

features.title: Website configuration
features.notes: mainPageSuffix/notFoundPage and object serving rules, not just metadata.

features.title: Usage/access logging configuration
features.notes: logBucket/logObjectPrefix and optional local event sink; no Cloud Logging service claim.

features.title: Default event-based hold

features.title: Uniform access configuration
features.notes: UBLA lockedTime and deprecated bucketPolicyOnly alias compatibility; ACL prohibitions enforced separately.

features.title: Public access prevention

features.title: Soft delete policy

features.title: Official Java SDK integration
features.notes: Pin a released Google Cloud Storage Java client. Exercise its supported HTTP and gRPC transports separately, endpoint override, streaming/resumable upload, pagination, preconditions and signed URLs. Record client/runtime/transport versions; no blanket SDK compatibility claim.

features.title: Official .NET SDK integration
features.notes: Pin Google.Cloud.Storage.V1 and a .NET runtime. Verify endpoint and credential setup plus streaming CRUD, resumable uploads, metadata, pagination, preconditions and signing against implemented features.

features.title: Official C++ SDK integration
features.notes: Pin google-cloud-cpp storage and the compiler/runtime. Verify the supported transports, endpoint override, streaming transfers, retries, pagination, preconditions and signed access. Keep client memory separate from emulator measurements.

features.title: Official PHP SDK integration
features.notes: Pin google/cloud-storage and PHP. Verify endpoint override, credential fixtures, upload/download, metadata, list pagination, preconditions and signed URLs.

features.title: gcloud storage command integration
features.notes: Use an isolated CLI configuration and endpoint overrides. Test buckets create/describe/list/delete, objects cp/ls/cat/rm, rsync, metadata and IAM commands only as their required endpoints are implemented; record exact commands and version. CLI overrides alone do not prove that signing, control APIs or authentication stay local.

features.title: Legacy gsutil compatibility scope
features.notes: Optional compatibility for existing scripts, with a pinned standalone gsutil and isolated configuration. Current documentation states gsutil will be unbundled from Google Cloud CLI after March 2027. Do not prioritize it over gcloud storage or imply that all gsutil operations are current GCS APIs.

features.title: S3-compatible client subset validation
features.notes: Verify the GCS-supported subset using pinned S3-capable clients and local HMAC credentials. Include supported signature/header and ACL syntax differences. Do not claim full Amazon S3 compatibility merely because GCS exposes an XML API.

features.title: Shared resource state across JSON XML and gRPC
features.notes: Write through each supported transport and read/list/modify through the others. Assert equivalent bytes, logical generations, metadata and authorization while preserving protocol-specific representations and errors. This is an integration gate distinct from independently passing each route.

features.title: Versioned API limits and optional quota model
features.notes: Track published immutable limits separately from adjustable production quotas and local resource budgets. Validate object/name/metadata/context/ACL/list/batch/multipart limits per operation. Make rate/quota simulation deterministic and opt-in; do not emulate cloud capacity or weaken protocol limits silently to meet local disk budgets.

features.title: HTTP body framing and connection semantics
features.notes: Test Content-Length, chunked transfer, empty bodies, truncated bodies, Expect: 100-continue where applicable, connection reuse, and HTTP/2 flow control. Reject malformed or incomplete uploads without publishing partial objects. Bound header/parser state as well as body buffers.

features.title: Disconnected-client resource cleanup
features.notes: Project requirement: slow clients, cancelled tasks and broken upload/download streams release permits, file handles and buffers promptly. Distinguish abandoned ordinary uploads from resumable sessions that must remain recoverable; verify no resource growth across repeated disconnects.

features.title: Disk exhaustion and write failure integrity
features.notes: Project requirement: inject full disk, inode exhaustion, permission failures and database-write failure. A failed upload must not corrupt the prior generation or expose partial state. Bound temporary-disk usage and report the local capacity limit explicitly.

features.title: File descriptor and active-session budgets
features.notes: Project requirement: cap open object files and persistent upload-session state independently of request concurrency. Spill/close idle handles and avoid O(number of stored objects) file descriptors; measure under many small objects and many abandoned sessions.

features.title: Catalog schema upgrade and compatibility policy
features.notes: Project requirement: version the persistent metadata format. Test upgrade with existing generations, permissions and resumable sessions; fail clearly on unsupported newer formats and avoid destructive implicit resets. Document downgrade/backup expectations.

features.title: Bounded telemetry and credential redaction
features.notes: Project requirement: structured request/operation IDs and bounded logging/metric buffers; avoid unbounded object-name or token label cardinality. Redact Authorization, signed query credentials, encryption keys and resumable capability URLs. Observability must not invalidate the memory target.

features.title: Safe blob reclamation during active reads
features.notes: Project requirement: overwrite/delete/lifecycle/restore/rename and background cleanup cannot reclaim bytes needed by an established generation-pinned read. Use a lifetime-aware reclamation strategy and test restart recovery of deferred/orphan bytes; do not hold long catalog transactions to protect readers.

features.title: Local IAM deny-policy evaluation boundary
features.notes: Allow-policy inheritance is already tracked. Add separately configured inherited deny rules only for supported Storage permissions, principals, exceptions and supported conditions; deny precedence must also affect ACL and signed-request decisions where applicable. Creating real IAM v2 deny policies remains outside the GCS emulator.

features.title: Organization policy effects beyond public access
features.notes: Local fixtures for Storage-specific constraints beyond existing PAP/UBLA rows, including authentication-type restrictions and permitted soft-delete retention settings. Document which constraint names and values are evaluated. Real Organization Policy administration is an external service.

features.title: Resource Manager tags and tag-binding boundary
features.notes: Bucket labels/XML tagging and Resource Manager tags are different features. Track direct/effective bucket tag bindings and their IAM/organization-policy uses. The real tagKeys/tagValues/tagBindings APIs belong to Resource Manager; an optional fixture adapter must be labeled simulated.

features.title: Tag-derived soft-delete defaults
features.interface: Bucket creation with external tag fixtures
features.notes: Support an optional inherited storage.defaultSoftDeletePolicy fixture for new buckets, with explicit bucket settings and allowed organization-policy values. Existing buckets must not be silently rewritten when the default changes; model propagation with a test clock if enabled.

features.title: Deprecated notification API scope registry
features.notes: Object change notification is deprecated as of 2026-01-30; it is distinct from Pub/Sub notification configuration/events already tracked. Record a deliberate historical support decision and exact source/version. Do not recreate old watch/channel endpoints by guesswork or infer shutdown merely from deprecation.

features.title: Behavioral release-note and restriction drift review
features.notes: Schema/proto drift is already tracked. Add semantic review of release notes and feature compatibility tables even when the wire schema does not change, for example lifecycle treatment of empty HNS folders, defaults, protocol restrictions, launches and deprecations. Add dated acceptance cases without overwriting prior compatibility claims.

features.notes: Track this observed v2 HTTP binding separately from google.storage.control.v2.StorageControl/ViewObjectFullContext and from storage.objects.viewFullContext in live v1 Discovery.
